Taiwan just announced that anyone caught shipping AI servers to China could face up to five years behind bars.

The move comes after a U.S. tariff deal and a high‑profile Super Micro raid, tightening export rules.

Will these harsh penalties curb illicit AI hardware trade, or push it further underground? 🤔
